entries.en: For the minimisation problem, a better feasible solution reduced the UB, but optimality was still unproved.
entries.zh: 对于这个最小化问题，一个更好的可行解降低了上限，但最优性仍未得到证明。

entries.en: The farm had only 3 kL of rainwater left after the long dry spell.
entries.zh: 长时间干旱过后，农场只剩下3千升雨水。

entries.en: The mutation lay just upstream of the RBS, not within the protein-coding region.
entries.zh: 这个突变位于核糖体结合部位的紧邻上游，而不在蛋白质编码区内。

entries.en: The laboratory used FIA to check the river-water samples collected downstream of the spill.
entries.zh: 实验室用流动注射分析检测了在泄漏点下游采集的河水样品。

entries.en: The display showed the wrong date because the program had treated BCD as ordinary binary.
entries.zh: 显示屏上的日期不对，因为程序把二-十进制编码当成了普通二进制。

entries.en: The network engineer checked the MIB to see whether the switch exposed a packet-error counter.
entries.zh: 网络工程师查看管理信息库，确认交换机是否提供了数据包错误计数器。

entries.meaningZh: 烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸
entries.en: The enzyme assay failed because the NAD solution had deteriorated during storage.
entries.zh: 由于烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸溶液在储存期间变质，酶测定失败了。

entries.en: A faulty a-c supply caused the laboratory instrument to switch off.
entries.zh: 有故障的交流电源导致实验室仪器关机。

entries.en: Congestion forced the router to lower its sending rate on the ABR connection.
entries.zh: 拥塞迫使路由器降低采用可用比特速率服务的连接上的发送速率。

entries.en: The call centre suspended ACD while the supervisor reassigned the agents to new teams.
entries.zh: 主管把接线员重新分组时，呼叫中心暂停了自动呼叫分配。

entries.en: The sender timed out while waiting for an ACK from the receiver.
entries.zh: 发送方在等待接收方的确认消息时超时了。

entries.en: An outdated ACL prevented the new analyst from opening the shared folder.
entries.zh: 一份过时的访问控制表使新来的分析人员无法打开共享文件夹。

entries.en: The programmer rewrote the geometry routine in AED so that the design team could reuse it.
entries.zh: 程序员用自动工程设计语言重写了几何计算例程，以便设计团队重复使用。

entries.en: The military ambulance reached the AFH before sunrise.
entries.zh: 军用救护车在日出前抵达了空军医院。

entries.en: With AGC switched off, the quiet speaker was barely audible in the recording.
entries.zh: 关闭自动增益控制后，录音中几乎听不清那位说话轻声的人。

entries.en: The committee used AHP to weigh maintenance cost against access for disabled passengers.
entries.zh: 委员会用层次分析法权衡维护成本与残障乘客的通行便利。

entries.en: The researcher consulted AISI's historical production tables before comparing the two decades.
entries.zh: 研究人员在比较这两个十年时期之前，查阅了美国钢铁学会的历史产量表。
